node.statement: Route F F2 positive-unital compression: let K >= 1 be a dimension-independent constant, n >= 1, Q: l_inf^n -> l_inf^n row-stochastic, D: M_n -> C^n diagonal extraction onto the complex diagonal algebra C^n = l_inf^n(C), J: C^n -> M_n diagonal inclusion, Q_C: C^n -> C^n the canonical complex-linear extension of Q, and Phi = J Q_C D, B a finite-dimensional unital C*-algebra, and Delta: B -> M_n, Upsilon: M_n -> B UCP maps; if 0 <= eta <= min{(24K)^{-1},1}, ||Delta Upsilon - Phi||_cb <= K*eta, ||Upsilon Delta - I_B||_cb <= K*eta, and ||Upsilon(Delta x Delta y) - xy|| <= K*eta*||x||*||y|| for all x,y in B, then B is commutative and there are k >= 1 and a unital *-isomorphism iota_C: C^k = l_inf^k(C) -> B such that D Delta iota_C maps R^k into R^n, iota_C^{-1} Upsilon J maps R^n into R^k, and the resulting restrictions and corestrictions A := (D Delta iota_C)|_{R^k}: l_inf^k -> l_inf^n and M := (iota_C^{-1} Upsilon J)|_{R^n}: l_inf^n -> l_inf^k are positive unital maps satisfying ||Q - AM||_{inf->inf} <= K*eta, ||QA - A||_{inf->inf} <= 2K*eta, and ||Ax||_inf >= (1-3K*eta)*||x||_inf for every x in l_inf^k.
